stories.title: The Seekers Club organizes Youth Talent Awards 2026
stories.summary: Our Lodhran Chapter honoured more than 50 young men and women for their talent, achievements and positive contribution to society.
body: The Seekers Club Lodhran Chapter successfully organized the Youth Talent Awards 2026 at the District Council Hall, Lodhran, to recognize and celebrate the talent, achievements, and positive contributions of young people from diverse fields.

More than 50 young men and women were honored with awards across various categories, including Youth Excellence, Influencers, Content Creators, Best Teachers, Motivational Speakers, Food Vloggers, Entrepreneurs, Blood Donors, and other areas of social and professional contribution.
The event was graced by Mr. Abdul Ammar Mun’am, Founder and Central President, The Seekers Club, who specially traveled from Islamabad to attend the ceremony as the Chief Guest.
## Celebrating Youth, Talent and Positive Impact

The event was organized by The Seekers Club Lodhran Chapter under the leadership of Chaudhry Ameer Ali and Hamza Tareen, who, along with their dedicated team, demonstrated remarkable organizational skills and successfully arranged the program within a very short period of time.
A number of prominent and influential local personalities also attended the event and encouraged the young participants and award recipients.
The program was beautifully hosted by Seemal Fatima and Hassan Fazal, whose confident and engaging presentation added energy and charm to the ceremony.

The event commenced with the recitation of the Holy Qur’an and Naat, followed by the national anthem. The audience was then entertained with national songs, Saraiki Jhoomar, and a Ghazal performance, creating a vibrant and culturally rich atmosphere.
## Message from the Chief Guest

Addressing the gathering, Abdul Ammar Mun’am, Founder and Central President of The Seekers Club, congratulated the organizers, award recipients, distinguished guests, and participants on the successful event.
He highlighted the journey of The Seekers Club, which began in 2015 and has gradually grown into a nationwide mission focused on youth development, social service, and community empowerment.

Speaking to the youth, he emphasized that academic degrees alone are no longer sufficient in the rapidly changing world. Young people must continuously develop their skills, digital capabilities, and knowledge of Artificial Intelligence (AI) to remain competitive and create meaningful opportunities for themselves and others.
He acknowledged the challenges faced by young people in the current environment but encouraged them not to lose hope.
> We must not only strive to stand on our own feet, but also become a source of strength and support for those who are less privileged and in need around us.
Explaining the purpose of his visit to Lodhran, he said that traveling such a long distance was intended to convey a clear message of encouragement and solidarity with the youth.
He also shared The Seekers Club’s youth-focused working plan and invited young people to come forward, become part of this journey, and contribute their share towards building a better society.
> Step forward, join this journey, and light your own candle of contribution.
## Inspiring Stories from Young Achievers
The event also provided an opportunity for youth representatives and award recipients to share their personal journeys, achievements, challenges, and success stories.

Their stories served as a source of motivation for other young participants and demonstrated how dedication, consistency, skills, and a positive mindset can enable young people to create meaningful impact in society.
## Appreciation for Organizers, Media and Participants

At the conclusion of the ceremony, the organizers expressed their gratitude to the Chief Guest, distinguished guests, award recipients, participants, volunteers, media representatives, and social media activists for their valuable participation and support.

Local press clubs, media representatives, and social media activists played an important role in providing extensive coverage to the event and highlighting the achievements of the participating youth.
Lunch boxes were also distributed among the participants.

The event concluded with group photographs and media interactions, marking a memorable occasion dedicated to recognizing youth talent, encouraging positive contributions, and strengthening the spirit of service and leadership among young people.
## The Seekers Club — Empowering Youth. Celebrating Talent. Serving Humanity.

The Youth Talent Awards 2026 reflected the core spirit of The Seekers Club: to recognize talent, inspire young people, promote positive social contribution, and create opportunities for youth to lead with purpose.

stories.title: Supporting cloudburst victims in Swabi, KPK
stories.summary: Cash assistance for families hit by the devastating cloudburst in Swabi.
body: A devastating cloudburst left many families in Swabi, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, without shelter, food and basic essentials.
The Seekers Club team stepped forward with a cash assistance drive, so that affected families could cover their most urgent needs straight away.
This relief was made possible by our donors and volunteers. Thank you for standing with families when they needed it most.

stories.title: Reaching out to families in Jalalpur Pirwala
stories.summary: Our South Punjab team served cooked meals to underprivileged households.
body: Volunteers from The Seekers Club South Punjab team served cooked meals to underprivileged households in Jalalpur Pirwala, so that no one in the community was left hungry.
Our work in Jalalpur Pirwala is part of a larger mission: to spread kindness, hope and humanity across communities, one act at a time.

stories.title: Cash distribution drive in Mansehra
stories.summary: Our KPK chapter gave direct cash support to families facing hardship.
body: The Seekers Club KPK Chapter organised a cash distribution drive in Mansehra for families facing economic hardship. Families could use the support for food, medicine, clothing or shelter.
The drive was carried out by local volunteers with the support of donors and the wider Seekers Club network.
More than financial help, it carried a simple message to every family: you are not alone, and we stand with you.

stories.title: Tree plantation and cooler distribution drive
stories.summary: Volunteers planted trees and gave water coolers to low-income households ahead of summer.
body: Volunteers, young people and local residents joined The Seekers Club to plant trees across local communities, working towards a greener, cleaner and healthier Pakistan.
Alongside the plantation, we distributed water coolers to low-income households so families could cope with the summer heat.
The drive was about more than planting saplings: it was about growing awareness and a shared sense of responsibility for our environment.

stories.title: Tree plantation drive, South Punjab Chapter
stories.summary: Our South Punjab chapter planted trees in schools, public spaces and community areas.
body: The South Punjab Chapter of The Seekers Club ran a tree plantation drive across schools, public spaces and community areas.
With help from volunteers, youth and local residents, the drive aimed to fight climate change, restore green spaces and leave a better environment for the next generation.

stories.title: Ration bag distribution, Sindh Chapter
stories.summary: Our Sindh chapter delivered ration bags with essential food items to families in need.
body: The Sindh Chapter of The Seekers Club ran a ration bag distribution drive, delivering essential food items to families facing economic hardship in underprivileged communities.
Our volunteers also took time to sit with families and listen to their concerns — a reminder that small acts of kindness can bring great comfort.
